_meta.description: Project type → Florida DBPR occupation codes for Plan matching. Prefer primary specialty codes; secondary only when local primary results are thin. Prefer active/current licenses in matching.ts.

kitchen_remodel.label: Kitchen Remodel
kitchen_remodel.notes: General/residential building licenses coordinate multi-trade kitchens. Plumbing (CFC) is secondary for fixture-heavy scopes, not a full kitchen GC substitute.

bathroom_remodel.label: Bathroom Remodel
bathroom_remodel.notes: Plumbing specialty is primary for wet-area work. CRC/CBC for residential/building remodels; CGC secondary for complex structural baths.

full_home_renovation.label: Full Home Renovation
full_home_renovation.notes: Multi-room work needs general, building, or residential contractor authority. No specialty-only primary codes.

addition.label: Addition / Extension
addition.notes: Structural additions require general/building/residential license class.

basement_finish.label: Basement / Lower-Level Finish
basement_finish.notes: Uncommon in FL; same GC classes as interior renovations.

roofing.label: Roofing
roofing.notes: Prefer certified (CCC) or registered (RR) roofing licenses. CGC only as secondary when local roofing specialty is thin — a GC may contract roofing but is not a roofing specialty substitute by default.

siding_exterior.label: Siding / Exterior
siding_exterior.notes: Building/residential/general for envelope re-clad. Specialty structure (SCC) secondary for certain enclosures/aluminum systems — not default siding.

deck_outdoor.label: Deck / Outdoor Living
deck_outdoor.notes: Outdoor structures often under building/residential/GC. SCC secondary for specialty structures/screen enclosures common in Florida.

custom_home_rebuild.label: New Custom Home / Knockdown Rebuild
custom_home_rebuild.notes: New construction / major rebuild: CGC and CBC preferred. CRC secondary for residential-scale rebuilds only.
